summary: Frontend-only testing of batch tool improvements in Pro Photo Sorter. Verified Settings modal 'Batch Behavior' section (max photos per batch input default 20, 3-way keep/move/delete toggle), persistence to localStorage key pps.state.v2 on Save, description text switching, Store Mode independence, Escape-to-close, clamping (max 500), and presence of all new Run Batch dropdown data-testids in the compiled bundle. No console errors. Photo-loading flows (actual batch execution, auto-enhance destination write, auto-apply-icons prompt) are SKIPPED - they require File System Access API directory picker (human interaction).

issues: Clearing the 'Max photos per batch' field instantly snaps the value to 20 (parseInt fallback), so users cannot type e.g. '5' by clearing then typing - they must select-all and overwrite. Minor UX nit only.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1719 lines - consider splitting batch logic (storeCurrent, batchAutoEnhance) into a hook/module per file-size guideline.

storeCurrent/batchAutoEnhance use window.confirm for limit + delete confirmation; functionally fine for an offline desktop app but not automatable/testable and inconsistent with the app's styled UI. Consider a shadcn AlertDialog.

batchAutoEnhance: when templateImg exists but destSelected is null, anchor falls back to destRoot - verify destRoot is guaranteed non-null at that point (early return only checks !templateImg && !destSelected).
seed_data_creation: Modified localStorage settings during test then reset back to defaults (moveMode:false, batchSizeLimit:20, batchAfterAction:'keep').
context_for_next_testing_agent: App uses File System Access API; source/destination pickers cannot be automated. Batch dropdown (data-testid batch-menu*) only renders when batchMode is on and batchSelected.size>0, which requires loaded photos - verified only via bundle string inspection. Settings modal fully automatable via [data-testid=open-settings].
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no failures found in testable scope.
